name: zai-cursor-limit
description: z.ai GLM Coding Plan quota traffic light: max/5h/weekly percentage in the status bar, colored robot text, per-level title bar tint

zaiCursorLimit.apiKey.description: API key of the z.ai GLM Coding Plan (works with the key from ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN)

zaiCursorLimit.statusbarEnabled.description: Show the indicator in the status bar; off also removes all color overrides

enumDescriptions: Show the larger of the two windows (default)
Always show the weekly window percentage
zaiCursorLimit.statusbarMetric.description: Which percentage the status bar number shows (the color level always follows the max)

zaiCursorLimit.colorRobotOnGreen.description: Color the robot text green while the level is green

zaiCursorLimit.colorRobotOnYellow.description: Color the robot text yellow while the level is yellow

zaiCursorLimit.colorRobotOnRed.description: Color the robot text red while the level is red

zaiCursorLimit.greenTextDark.description: Green: robot text on dark themes

zaiCursorLimit.greenTextLight.description: Green: robot text on light themes

zaiCursorLimit.yellowTextDark.description: Yellow: robot text on dark themes

zaiCursorLimit.yellowTextLight.description: Yellow: robot text on light themes

zaiCursorLimit.redTextDark.description: Red: robot text on dark themes

zaiCursorLimit.redTextLight.description: Red: robot text on light themes

zaiCursorLimit.yellowPct.description: Yellow threshold, percent of the max window (5h vs weekly)

zaiCursorLimit.redPct.description: Red threshold, percent of the max window (5h vs weekly)

zaiCursorLimit.tintTitlebarOnGreen.description: Tint the window title bar green while the level is green

zaiCursorLimit.tintTitlebarOnYellow.description: Tint the window title bar yellow while the level is yellow

zaiCursorLimit.tintTitlebarOnRed.description: Tint the window title bar red while the level is red

zaiCursorLimit.greenTintDark.description: Green: title bar tint on dark themes

zaiCursorLimit.greenTintLight.description: Green: title bar tint on light themes

zaiCursorLimit.yellowTintDark.description: Yellow: title bar tint on dark themes

zaiCursorLimit.yellowTintLight.description: Yellow: title bar tint on light themes

zaiCursorLimit.redTintDark.description: Red (burgundy): title bar tint on dark themes

zaiCursorLimit.redTintLight.description: Red: title bar tint on light themes
